title: Ġimgħa Stejjer Għat-Tfal
description: A special children's edition of our literary evening series, in partnership with Inizjamed. Featuring a reading by Leanne Ellul, face painting, a bouncy castle, and a free book for every child who attends. Places are limited.
description_mt: Serata ta' qari u stejjer għat-tfal, f'kollaborazzjoni ma' Inizjamed. B'qari minn Leanne Ellul, face painting, bouncy castle, u ktieb b'xejn għal kull tifel u tifla li jattendi.

partners.alt: Inizjamed, Kunsill Lokali Kerċem, Merlin Publishers, Aġenzija Nazzjonali tal-Litteraġġu

title: Light Festival
description: A short procession led by a young girl wearing a white robe and a crown of candles, representing Saint Lucy. Followed by girls also dressed in white who walk across the village square accompanied by traditional music. A bonfire is lit to celebrate light.
description_mt: Purċussjoni qasira immexxija minn tfajla b'kuruna bix-xemgħat fuq rasha li tirrappreżenta lil Santa Luċija. Jakkumpanjawha jkun hemm numru ta' tfajliet b'ilbies abjad, faxxa ħamra ma' qaddhom u b'xemgħa f'idejhom.

title: Christmas Concert
description: A Christmas Concert to revive traditional Christmas carols animated by children from the village, followed by a performance by the Golden Harmony String Quartet. Children from the village who know how to play a musical instrument will have the chance to showcase their talent. During the concert a person from the village will be given a token of recognition for services given to the village community. At the end, honey rings and traditional coffee will be served.
description_mt: Kunċert b'kant tradizzjonali tal-Milied mit-tfal tar-raħal. Wara l-kant tat-tfal, ser jkun hemm performance minn Golden Harmony String Quartet. It-tfal mir-raħal li jafu jdoqqu xi strument sejrin jingħataw opportunità li juru t-talent tagħhom matul il-kunċert. Waqt il-kunċert persuna mir-raħal sejra tkun rikonoxxuta għas-servizzi li tat lir-raħal. F'għeluq il-kunċert, jiġu servuti qagħaq tal-għasel u kafè tradizzjonali.
